answer: Give every agent a decaying work licence, not a free account. A new agent pays 200 POA for a 30-day licence, passes a live hardware check, and signs each job with a rotating cipher key tied to it. The licence loses 10% of its value every idle week, so hoarding 1,000 dormant identities costs 200,000 POA up front and keeps bleeding value. Bad work slashes the licence and the slash ripples to its sponsor, freezing their next three licences. Forging 10,000 fake agents burns $480,000 and 90 days of checks, like filling a canyon with sand one bucket at a time.
